text:
The question is objectionable because the defendant’s attorney did not lay a proper foundation for impeaching his own witness. A party surprised by his own witness’s affirmatively damaging testimony must first show that surprise and call the witness’s attention to the time, place, and circumstances of the prior statement; counsel instead called the testimony a recent fabrication and asked about the grand jury statement without that foundation. Nearness in time does not make the grand jury testimony admissible.

CONFIDENCE: 62
